description: Hex viewer / editor / comparer with firmware formats (Intel HEX, S-Record, TI-TXT, ELF, BIN).
cfg.defaultUnit: Default display unit in bytes (1, 2 or 4).
cfg.littleEndian: Interpret 2/4 byte units and Data Inspector values as little-endian.
cfg.readOnlyByDefault: Open the Hex++ editor in read-only mode (toggle with Insert).
cfg.copyDefaultFormat: Format used by Ctrl+C. 'displayed' copies exactly what is shown (respects 1/2/4 byte units).
cfg.fillByte: Byte used to fill gaps when exporting to BIN.
cfg.recordLength: Data bytes per record when exporting Intel HEX / S-Record / TI-TXT.
